Display Still in Love (Summer Tracksuit)

■ Direction
Confusion

A real race... That fierce, beautiful clash stole my heart away.
I wanted to dive in there too... Everything was normal until then, but...

You searched... and found me...?
Little old me...?

.........Yes.
In that case... please... take care of me...

...I should have just devoured it all right then and there!
Drinking down every last dripping drop... Aaaah...—
...Ghhh!
Special... me...?

Even so, I myself was... already utterly enchanted by racing.
Instead of walking away, I chose the path of suppressing the madness... and as a result, we split.

Because... the way that girl runs is... hideous.
Lewd, shameful... a monster, through and through.

N-No... It's... strange, isn't it?
...It isn't normal. There must be something wrong with me...

...! I-I am so sorry...
To let you see me in such a dreadful state...! I am so deeply ashamed...

Looking into her fixed crimson gaze, the shadow of her ferocious "other self" flickered across it... making me shiver.
Yet, as if gripped by fever, my mouth moved before I could think.

...Ngh, no!! ...I'm not you...
You are... me... No, no...!!

My throat feels parched. I desperately want to see that run again...
—So much so that I wouldn't care what happened to me in return.

You must have been terrified as well.
...Disgusted, surely—

"HRUP." Focus, and "scoop it up."
"Her" "instinct." Close your eyes—

Especially when competing against someone strong... she begins to run wild.
She gets overexcited, loses her senses... and when I regain consciousness, I am... alone.

Putting it into words made everything click. Why was I so fixated on her?
—I had been utterly captivated by her bewitching, demonic stride.

...On the final stretch. I felt raw instinct clashing against instinct with my very skin.
At that moment, chills ran down my spine... and "something" whispered to me.

...Ever since then. That was when everything started going mad...
Whenever it comes to races... she began to emerge.

...
I have... a proposal for you—

It was certainly a destructive style of running that gave no heed to her own body or her surroundings.
Yet, if we could properly tame that power... that raw instinct—

It is true that she might not fit into what the world considers "normal."
However, that simply means—

Still in Love?
No, haven't seen her.

Driven by urgency, I strained my ears just as told. And then,
I "held her in my thoughts"... that run, those crimson eyes like blood—

...Ngh. No... I can't...!
I must not show such an unsightly side of myself... any longer...!

Neo Universe is a "crewmate."
That is why—I understand. I will "communicate."

I shouted reflexively. It was true that I felt fear toward her.
However, it was not out of malice as she suspected, but rather...
Ah... W-Why are you...?

Ah, how shameful...! Please, stop...
Why must you... Why...

Aha. You love it too, deep down.
It's no use pretending to be pure. I am... you, remember?

—My head aches. Noise and whispers flood my thoughts...
The sounds echoing inside my mind gradually coalesce into one—

...Are you sure? She is... uncontrollable.
She might... do something terrible to you...

C　　　o　　　m　　　e
　　　o　　v　　e　　r
　　　　h　e　r　e

All that remained within me was... an excitement so intense that the line between self and other blurred.
And then... the impulse. A scorching thirst to devour everything.

"Blood, the moon, and transgression.
Such are the sins of our fated bond"—so it said.

Listen closely.
"Hold in your thoughts"—"Still in Love."

Impatience set in. Still in Love was clearly not herself.
Leaving her alone in that state... gave me a dangerous premonition.

Hmm... Can't say I've seen her.
...Trainer, you're dripping with sweat... Are you alright?

Ah~ She hasn't come over this way.
...Come to think of it, where does she usually hang out?

Now I understood. Because of the clashing personas within her, the impression she gave
was completely inverted. And torn by that inner conflict, she—

It sprouted... or rather, perhaps I should say it awakened.
The very first time I visited the Twinkle Series—

The "I" who strives to be rational.
And the "me" who runs on pure instinct, screaming to devour everything.

Though it was easy to be overwhelmed by its bizarreness, the running she displayed
had an undeniable brilliance to it, both in raw speed and sheer power.

............
Turn her... into a weapon...

—It exists... within me.
The blood of madness... whispering to defy all decency.

Enduring the headache, I followed the ever-growing commotion to its source...
Where she was writhed in solitary agony.
